courses.title: Basic Computer & Internet Literacy
courses.prereq: None — designed for absolute first-time users.
courses.bestFor: Seniors, homemakers, and Tier-2/3 learners entering the digital economy.
courses.brief: File management, browsers, email, safe internet use, and government/UPI portals.
learn: Computer parts, operating a Windows PC, keyboard & mouse basics
Files & folders — create, rename, copy, move, search, and back up
Web browsers — searching, tabs, bookmarks, downloads, and clearing history
Email — creating an account, composing, attachments, spam, and etiquette
Everyday government & utility portals — DigiLocker, UPI apps, online bill payment
Staying safe — recognising scams, strong passwords, and privacy basics
courses.handsOn: Set up an email account, send an email with an attachment, and complete a mock UPI payment.
courses.outcome: Confidently use a computer and the internet for daily life; ready for Basic Excel or Google Workspace.

courses.title: Basic Microsoft Excel
courses.bestFor: Anyone entering an office/data role — the most-requested office skill in India.
courses.brief: Cells, formulas, sorting, filtering, and simple charts.
learn: Workbook & worksheet navigation, entering and formatting data
Cell references (relative vs absolute) and the fill handle
Core formulas — SUM, AVERAGE, COUNT, MIN, MAX, IF
Sorting, filtering, and freezing panes
Basic charts — column, line, and pie
Printing, page setup, and saving/exporting to PDF
courses.handsOn: Build a monthly household or shop expense tracker with totals and a chart.
courses.outcome: Handle everyday spreadsheets at work; next step Advanced Excel.

courses.title: Advanced Excel
courses.bestFor: Analysts, accountants, and managers who work in spreadsheets daily.
courses.brief: Pivot tables, lookups, and dashboards for analysts and managers.
learn: PivotTables & PivotCharts — grouping, slicers, and calculated fields
Lookup functions — VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, HLOOKUP
Logical & text functions — nested IF, IFS, CONCAT, TEXT, LEFT/RIGHT/MID
Conditional formatting and data validation (dropdowns)
What-if analysis — Goal Seek, Scenario Manager, Data Tables
Building an interactive dashboard with charts and controls
courses.handsOn: Create a sales dashboard from raw transaction data with slicers and KPIs.
courses.outcome: Do real reporting/analysis; next step Excel Macros & VBA or Power BI.

courses.title: Excel Automation with Macros & VBA
courses.prereq: Advanced Excel; some comfort with formulas.
courses.bestFor: Finance/operations staff who repeat the same reports every week.
courses.brief: Recording macros and writing VBA to automate repetitive reporting.
learn: Recording, editing, and running macros; the Developer tab
The VBA editor, modules, and the object model (Workbook/Worksheet/Range)
Variables, loops (For/Do), and conditionals (If/Select Case)
Automating formatting, data cleanup, and multi-sheet consolidation
Building custom functions (UDFs) and simple UserForms
Error handling and scheduling/triggering macros
courses.handsOn: Build a one-click macro that imports data, cleans it, and generates a formatted report.
courses.outcome: Automate hours of manual work; a strong resume differentiator.

courses.title: Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Forms)
courses.bestFor: Students, startups, and remote teams that collaborate online.
courses.brief: Cloud collaboration and Forms surveys.
learn: Google Drive — storage, sharing, permissions, and version history
Docs — collaborative writing, comments, suggestions, and templates
Sheets — formulas, sharing, and basic charts (with Excel differences)
Slides — quick decks and real-time co-editing
Forms — building surveys/quizzes and reading responses in Sheets
Google Meet & Calendar basics for team coordination
courses.handsOn: Run a live feedback survey with Forms and auto-summarise responses in Sheets.
courses.outcome: Collaborate smoothly in any modern workplace.

courses.title: Microsoft Word — Professional Documents
courses.bestFor: Anyone creating resumes, reports, and business documents.
courses.brief: Styles, templates, and mail-merge for resumes, reports, and letters.
learn: Text formatting, paragraph spacing, and page layout
Styles, headings, and an auto Table of Contents
Templates for resumes, letters, and reports
Tables, images, headers/footers, and page numbers
Mail-merge for bulk letters/certificates
Track changes, comments, and exporting to PDF
courses.handsOn: Produce a professional resume and a mail-merged certificate batch.
courses.outcome: Create polished documents; pairs well with PowerPoint.

courses.title: PowerPoint & Presentation Design
courses.bestFor: Students and professionals who pitch, report, or teach.
courses.brief: Slide structure, visual hierarchy, and storytelling decks that hold an audience.
learn: Slide structure and the one-idea-per-slide principle
Visual hierarchy, fonts, colour, and whitespace
Slide masters, layouts, and reusable templates
Charts, SmartArt, icons, and image treatment
Transitions, animations, and speaker notes (used tastefully)
Delivery — presenter view, timing, and handling Q&A
courses.handsOn: Design and deliver a 10-slide pitch or project deck.
courses.outcome: Present with confidence; pairs with Public Speaking.

courses.title: Data Analytics with Python & SQL
courses.prereq: Basic Excel and comfort with computers; no coding needed to start.
courses.bestFor: Career-starters targeting analyst roles in IT, BFSI, e-commerce, consulting.
courses.brief: The flagship path — Excel to SQL to Python to BI dashboards.
learn: The analytics workflow — question, data, clean, analyse, present
SQL — SELECT, joins, GROUP BY, subqueries, and window functions
Python for data — Pandas for cleaning, merging, and aggregation; NumPy basics
Exploratory data analysis and descriptive statistics
Charting with Matplotlib/Seaborn and dashboarding in Power BI/Tableau
Data storytelling — turning findings into recommendations
courses.handsOn: End-to-end capstone — pull data with SQL, analyse in Python, present a dashboard.
courses.outcome: Target Data Analyst / Business Analyst roles; next step Data Engineering or Machine Learning.

courses.title: SQL for Data & Business
courses.bestFor: Analysts, PMs, marketers — anyone who needs to pull their own data.
courses.brief: The universal data language every analyst and PM needs.
learn: Databases, tables, and the SELECT statement
Filtering (WHERE), sorting (ORDER BY), and DISTINCT
Aggregations — COUNT, SUM, AVG with GROUP BY and HAVING
Joins — INNER, LEFT/RIGHT, and self-joins
Subqueries, CTEs, and window functions (ROW_NUMBER, RANK)
Data types, NULL handling, and query optimisation basics
courses.handsOn: Answer 10 business questions from a sample e-commerce database.
courses.outcome: Query any database confidently; feeds Data Analytics and Power BI.

courses.title: Business Analytics with Power BI
courses.prereq: Excel basics; SQL helpful but not required.
courses.bestFor: Professionals in product, operations, finance, and consulting.
courses.brief: Data models, DAX, and interactive dashboards.

Data modelling — relationships, star schema, and normalisation
DAX — measures, calculated columns, and time-intelligence
Visuals — charts, cards, maps, slicers, and drill-through
Dashboard design, bookmarks, and interactivity
Publishing to the Power BI Service and scheduled refresh
courses.handsOn: Build and publish an interactive sales-and-operations dashboard.
courses.outcome: Build reports leaders rely on; a high-demand standalone skill.

courses.title: Data Visualization with Tableau
courses.bestFor: Analysts and anyone presenting data to decision-makers.
courses.brief: Turning raw data into clear, decision-ready dashboards and stories.
learn: Connecting data sources and understanding dimensions vs measures
Core chart types and when to use each
Calculated fields, parameters, and table calculations
Filters, groups, sets, and hierarchies
Dashboards, actions, and story points
Visual best practice — colour, labels, and avoiding chart junk
courses.handsOn: Create a multi-view dashboard and a guided data story.
courses.outcome: Communicate data visually; complements Power BI.

courses.title: Advanced Excel for Data Analysis
courses.bestFor: Analysts who prefer to stay in Excel before moving to BI tools.
courses.brief: Power Query, Power Pivot, and statistics for spreadsheet analysts.
learn: Power Query — importing, cleaning, and transforming data
Power Pivot and the data model with relationships
Intro to DAX measures inside Excel
Statistical functions — regression, correlation, forecasting
Advanced lookups, array formulas, and dynamic arrays (FILTER, SORT, UNIQUE)
Interactive dashboards with slicers and timelines
courses.handsOn: Build a self-refreshing analytics workbook from multiple data files.
courses.outcome: Do serious analysis without leaving Excel; natural bridge to Power BI.

courses.title: Statistics for Analysts & Data Science
courses.bestFor: Aspiring data analysts/scientists who want trustworthy results.
courses.brief: The maths behind trustworthy analysis.
learn: Descriptive statistics — mean, median, variance, distributions
Probability fundamentals and common distributions
Sampling, confidence intervals, and the central limit theorem
Hypothesis testing — t-tests, chi-square, ANOVA
Correlation vs causation and regression basics
Reading results honestly — p-values, significance, and pitfalls
courses.handsOn: Run and interpret an A/B test on sample data.
courses.outcome: Analyse and test with rigour; essential before Machine Learning.

courses.title: Data Engineering Fundamentals
courses.bestFor: Analysts/developers moving into high-paying data-engineering roles.

Batch vs streaming and the ETL/ELT paradigm
Building pipelines and orchestration (Airflow concepts)
Distributed processing with Apache Spark
Working with cloud warehouses (BigQuery/Redshift/Snowflake concepts)
Data quality, partitioning, and cost/performance basics

courses.outcome: Target Data Engineer roles with a strong salary premium.

courses.title: Google Analytics 4 & Web Analytics
courses.bestFor: Marketers, founders, and product folks measuring digital growth.
courses.brief: Event tracking, funnels, and attribution to measure and grow digital products.

Setting up properties, data streams, and events
Key reports — acquisition, engagement, retention, monetization
Conversions, funnels, and exploration reports
Audiences, segments, and attribution models

courses.title: AI Literacy & Everyday Productivity

courses.prereq: AI Literacy (or comfort using AI tools).

Techniques — few-shot, chain-of-thought, and step-by-step decomposition
System prompts and controlling tone, length, and structure

Reducing hallucination — grounding, citations, and verification

courses.outcome: Get expert-level results from AI; feeds Generative AI development.

scikit-learn pipelines and avoiding overfitting

Image classification with CNNs and transfer learning

Real-world use cases across finance, supply chain, and identity
The Web3 landscape and where the industry is heading
courses.handsOn: Map a real-world use case to a blockchain solution and justify why it does (or does not) fit.
courses.outcome: Confidently explain blockchain and Web3; ready for Blockchain Fundamentals.

courses.title: Blockchain Fundamentals: Blocks, Hashing & Consensus
courses.prereq: Introduction to Blockchain & Web3 (or basic blockchain awareness).
courses.bestFor: Beginners who want the technical foundations behind blockchain.
courses.brief: Blocks, hashes, cryptography, distributed ledgers, and consensus (PoW/PoS).
learn: Anatomy of a block and how blocks chain together
Cryptographic hashing and why it makes chains tamper-evident
Public/private keys and digital signatures
Distributed ledgers, nodes, and peer-to-peer networks
Consensus mechanisms — Proof of Work vs Proof of Stake
Mining, validation, and how new blocks are added
courses.handsOn: Trace a transaction from wallet to confirmed block and hash a sample block with a tool.
courses.outcome: Understand how blockchains stay secure and agree on truth.

courses.title: Cryptocurrency & Digital Assets Fundamentals
courses.bestFor: Beginners wanting a safe, practical grounding in crypto and digital assets.
courses.brief: How cryptocurrencies, wallets, keys, tokens, and exchanges actually work.
learn: How cryptocurrencies work and what gives them value
Wallets, public/private keys, and seed phrases
Sending, receiving, and confirming transactions
Coins vs tokens and common token types
Exchanges (centralised vs decentralised) and custody
Security, scams, and safe self-custody practices
courses.handsOn: Set up a test wallet, send a testnet transaction, and trace it on a block explorer.
courses.outcome: Use and reason about digital assets safely — without hype. Educational only, not financial advice.

courses.title: Blockchain Architecture & Networks
courses.bestFor: Developers and architects going deeper into how networks run.
courses.brief: Nodes, peer-to-peer networks, forks, validation, and types of blockchain networks.
learn: Network topology and node types (full, light, validator)
Peer-to-peer networking and message propagation
Transaction lifecycle, the mempool, and block validation
Forks — soft vs hard — and chain reorganisations
Public, private, permissioned, and consortium networks
Throughput, finality, and the scalability trilemma
courses.handsOn: Diagram a blockchain network's architecture and compare two consensus/network designs.
courses.outcome: Reason about network design trade-offs; foundation for building on-chain.

courses.title: Ethereum & Smart Contracts
courses.bestFor: Aspiring Web3 developers starting with Ethereum.
courses.brief: Ethereum accounts, gas, the EVM, smart contracts, and decentralised apps.
learn: Ethereum accounts (EOA vs contract) and transactions
Gas, fees, and how the network prices computation
The Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) and state
What smart contracts are and how they execute
Decentralised applications (dApps) and how they use contracts
Test networks, faucets, and developer tooling overview
courses.handsOn: Deploy a pre-written smart contract to a testnet and call it from a wallet.
courses.outcome: Understand Ethereum end to end; ready for Solidity.

courses.title: Solidity Programming for Beginners
courses.prereq: Ethereum & Smart Contracts; basic programming logic.
courses.bestFor: Developers learning to write smart contracts.
courses.brief: Solidity from scratch — variables, functions, mappings, structs, inheritance.
learn: Solidity syntax, types, and contract structure
Functions, visibility, and state vs memory
Arrays, mappings, and structs
Events, modifiers, and error handling (require/revert)
Inheritance, interfaces, and libraries
Compiling, deploying, and testing with Remix/Hardhat
courses.handsOn: Write, test, and deploy your own smart contract (e.g. a simple bank or voting contract).
courses.outcome: Build working smart contracts; ready for DApp development.

courses.title: Build Your First Blockchain DApp
courses.bestFor: Developers ready to ship their first full dApp.
courses.brief: Build a decentralised app — smart contract, web frontend, and wallet.
learn: dApp architecture — contracts, frontend, and provider
Connecting a wallet (MetaMask) with ethers.js/web3.js
Reading from and writing to a smart contract
Handling transactions, confirmations, and errors
Displaying on-chain data in a web UI
Deploying the contract and hosting the frontend
courses.handsOn: Ship a working dApp end to end (e.g. a message board or tip jar) on a testnet.
courses.outcome: Build and deploy full decentralised applications.

courses.title: Advanced Solidity & Smart Contract Development
courses.bestFor: Developers building complex, production-grade contracts.
courses.brief: Advanced contract architecture, patterns, optimisation, and security-aware design.
learn: Advanced contract architecture and patterns (proxy/upgradeable)
Reusable contracts and OpenZeppelin libraries
Gas optimisation and storage layout
Advanced events, errors, and low-level calls
Security-aware coding and common pitfalls
Testing strategies and coverage with Hardhat/Foundry
courses.handsOn: Build an upgradeable, gas-optimised contract system with a full test suite.
courses.outcome: Write robust, efficient, production-ready contracts.

courses.title: Smart Contract Security & Auditing
courses.bestFor: Developers and auditors securing on-chain code.
courses.brief: Vulnerabilities, secure coding, testing, and the fundamentals of auditing.
learn: Common vulnerabilities — reentrancy, overflow, access control
The auditor's mindset and threat modelling
Secure coding patterns and checks-effects-interactions
Testing, fuzzing, and static analysis (Slither, Echidna)
Real attack case studies and post-mortems
Writing an audit report with findings and remediations
courses.handsOn: Audit a deliberately vulnerable contract and produce a findings report.
courses.outcome: Identify and fix contract vulnerabilities; target auditing roles.

courses.title: Token Development: ERC-20, ERC-721 & ERC-1155
courses.bestFor: Developers building fungible and non-fungible tokens.
courses.brief: Build your own tokens using the ERC-20, ERC-721, and ERC-1155 standards.
learn: How token standards work and why they matter
ERC-20 fungible tokens — supply, transfers, allowances
ERC-721 NFTs — ownership, metadata, and minting
ERC-1155 multi-token contracts
Using OpenZeppelin to build safely
Deploying, verifying, and listing tokens
courses.handsOn: Develop and deploy your own ERC-20 token and an ERC-721 NFT collection.
courses.outcome: Ship compliant tokens and NFTs to a testnet or mainnet.

courses.title: NFTs & Decentralized Applications
courses.bestFor: Developers building NFT-based products and marketplaces.
courses.brief: NFT metadata, ownership, marketplaces, and building an NFT app.
learn: How NFTs work — tokens, metadata, and standards
Storing metadata and media (IPFS/Arweave)
Minting flows and royalties
Marketplaces and how listings/sales work
Building an NFT gallery/minting dApp
Practical NFT use cases beyond art
courses.handsOn: Build an NFT minting + gallery dApp with on-chain ownership.
courses.outcome: Build practical NFT applications.

courses.title: Web3 Development with JavaScript/Node.js
courses.bestFor: Web developers connecting apps to the blockchain.
courses.brief: Wallet interaction, RPCs, APIs, and contract calls with JavaScript/Node.js.
learn: Connecting to blockchains via RPC providers (Infura/Alchemy)
ethers.js/web3.js — reading state and sending transactions
Wallet connection and signing in the browser
Listening to events and indexing on-chain data
Building backend services and APIs around contracts
Transaction management, nonces, and error handling
courses.handsOn: Build a Node.js service + frontend that reads and writes to a smart contract.
courses.outcome: Integrate blockchain into modern JS/Node apps.

courses.title: Blockchain Development with PHP & Node.js
courses.prereq: Web development in PHP or Node.js.
courses.bestFor: Web developers integrating blockchain into existing applications.
courses.brief: Integrate blockchain features into traditional PHP/Node.js apps and databases.
learn: When to use blockchain alongside a traditional backend
Calling blockchain nodes/RPCs from PHP and Node.js
Verifying signatures and payments server-side
Syncing on-chain events into a SQL database
Building hybrid on-chain/off-chain workflows
Security, keys, and secrets management
courses.handsOn: Add a blockchain-verified feature (e.g. a payment or record proof) to a PHP/Node app.
courses.outcome: Bring Web3 features into real production web stacks.

courses.title: Building Production-Ready Web3 Applications
courses.bestFor: Developers shipping complete, secure Web3 products.
courses.brief: Design, build, test, secure, and deploy full blockchain applications.
learn: Full-stack Web3 architecture (contracts, backend, frontend, infra)
Environments, testnets, and deployment pipelines
Testing, CI, and security reviews before launch
Wallet UX, error states, and gas handling
Indexing, monitoring, and scaling
Mainnet deployment and post-launch operations
courses.handsOn: Take a Web3 app from design through a tested, secured, mainnet-ready deployment.
courses.outcome: Ship production-grade Web3 products end to end.

courses.title: Blockchain Projects: Build 5 Real-World Applications
courses.bestFor: Developers building a strong Web3 portfolio.
courses.brief: A project-based program building five practical blockchain applications.
learn: Project 1 — a token system with distribution
Project 2 — on-chain certificate verification
Project 3 — a decentralised voting demonstration
Project 4 — an NFT application
Project 5 — a blockchain-based records/registry
Packaging the work into a hireable portfolio
courses.handsOn: Build and deploy all five applications as portfolio-ready projects.
courses.outcome: Graduate with five shipped Web3 projects.

courses.title: Blockchain Architecture & Enterprise Solutions
courses.prereq: Solid blockchain development and architecture experience.
courses.bestFor: Architects and leads designing enterprise blockchain systems.
courses.brief: Scalability, permissioned networks, interoperability, governance, and privacy.
learn: Enterprise requirements and when blockchain fits
Permissioned and consortium networks (Hyperledger, etc.)
Scalability — layer 2, sharding, and rollups
Interoperability and cross-chain communication
Governance, privacy, and compliance
Architectural decision-making and trade-offs
courses.handsOn: Produce an enterprise blockchain architecture and decision document for a real use case.
courses.outcome: Design blockchain solutions at enterprise scale.

courses.title: Blockchain & Decentralized Finance (DeFi)
courses.bestFor: Developers and analysts building or evaluating DeFi.
courses.brief: DEXs, lending, liquidity pools, AMMs, and the architecture behind DeFi.
learn: What DeFi is and its building blocks
Decentralised exchanges and automated market makers (AMMs)
Liquidity pools, LP tokens, and impermanent loss
Lending, borrowing, and collateralisation
Oracles, stablecoins, and yield strategies
DeFi risks, exploits, and security

courses.title: Blockchain Capstone Project
courses.prereq: Completion of the core blockchain track (Solidity, dApps, Web3).

learn: Requirements gathering and scoping a real project
System architecture and smart-contract design
Full implementation — contracts, backend, and frontend
Security review and comprehensive testing
Deployment and infrastructure
Documentation and a final project defence
